current_prompt.body:
READ the list L of 45 distinct positive integers
VERIFY whether L can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for every triple i in {1,...,15}
IF such a partition exists, CONSTRUCT one complete example of the 15 triples meeting the condition
RETURN a statement indicating existence of the partition and, when it exists, the example triples
